text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (September 9, 2024) for 1969 Eglinton Avenue West.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (September 9, 2024) for 1969 Eglinton Avenue West, Folder Number 24 210253 PRS 00 IV, as the appellant did not appear before the Panel and did not provide any evidence of how long the work would take to complete.
